guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Shell Perdido 深水監測
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring
guides.concept: 以海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識解析Shell Perdido 深水監測：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring through subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識深水reservoir假說。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識井筒與壓力containment。多個屏障路徑與監測共同支持完整性；概念課不提供鑽井或井控操作參數。 建立井筒屏障與完整性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用原創功能圖區分承壓路徑與監測，不設計現場操作。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海底多相pump。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識浮平臺與riser界面。立管、海底設備與上部處理各有壓力、運動及可維修邊界。 建立海底連接與平臺的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫平臺—海底接口並標海況及維護假設。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識處理與digital能量。分離、壓縮與冷卻消耗能量；岸電改變部分排放邊界而不使全生命週期零排放。 建立處理能量與排放的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識AI診斷與獨立證據。可用率受維護、完整性與供能限制；只做公開報告和假想事件分析。 建立監測停機與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify deepwater-reservoir hypotheses in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify well/pressure containment in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Multiple barriers/monitoring support integrity; conceptual courses supply no drilling or well-control settings. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well barriers and integrity, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify subsea multiphase pumps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of multiphase transport and pressure drop, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify floating-platform/riser interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Risers, subsea systems and topsides have distinct pressure, motion and serviceability boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of subsea links and platforms, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify processing/digital energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Separation, compression and cooling use energy; shore power shifts some emissions without making lifecycle emissions zero. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of processing energy and emissions, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify ai diagnosis/independent evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Maintenance, integrity and energy affect availability; analyze public reports/assumed events only. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, shutdown and recovery, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交處理與digital能量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交AI診斷與獨立證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交AI診斷與獨立證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for processing/digital energy.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for ai diagnosis/independent evidence.

pitfalls: 常見誤判：恢復產量本身就證明所有安全狀態均正確。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Recovered production proves every safety state correct.

related.transfer: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.transferEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識；Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程改以海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis; Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering centers on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照深水reservoir假說與天然氣資源與庫存，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

以AI診斷與獨立證據為起點，設計一項能區分「海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識」與「海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare deepwater-reservoir hypotheses with gas resources/inventory and redraw inputs and boundaries.

Start from ai diagnosis/independent evidence and propose an observation distinguishing subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis from offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries, including uncertainty.
